hero.title: MindWell
hero.subtitle: Open-Source Mental Health Platform
hero.description: Comprehensive, scientifically-backed, free mental health support with 393 disorders, 20 validated assessments, 16 therapeutic games, 14 meditations, 20 therapy techniques, and crisis resources.
hero.headline: Your Mental Health Matters

bangladesh.title: Free Services in Bangladesh 🇧🇩
bangladesh.description: All MindWell services are completely free for users in Bangladesh. We are committed to making mental health support accessible to everyone.

sdg.title: SDG 3: Good Health & Well-Being
sdg.description: MindWell contributes to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 by providing accessible mental health resources and support to communities worldwide.
sdg.impactNote: As a non-profit, open-source initiative, MindWell demonstrates how technology can advance public health goals and contribute to national and global well-being.
